pharm: Acts as an immunomodulator that promotes maturation and activation of dendritic cells and stimulates both cell-mediated and humoral immune responses, enhancing host defense against recurrent respiratory infections
quick: 800 mg twice daily during acute phase, then 800 mg once daily (per regional product information)
Usually taken away from meals; follow the local product information
summary: Pidotimod is a synthetic immunostimulant used (mainly in Europe and Asia) as adjunctive therapy for recurrent or chronic respiratory and urinary tract infections, particularly in children and the elderly, to support immune function. It is not FDA-approved; dosing and indications are based on regional product information rather than an FDA label.
indications: Adjunctive treatment of recurrent or chronic respiratory tract infections (per regional product information)
Adjunctive treatment of recurrent urinary tract infections (per regional product information)
Support of immune function in patients prone to recurrent infections

dosage.d: 800 mg twice daily in the acute phase, then 800 mg once daily for maintenance
dosage.t: Course typically up to several weeks per local guidance
dosage.n: Per regional (e.g. Italian/Asian) product information; not FDA-defined

dosage.d: 400 mg twice daily in the acute phase, then 400 mg once daily
dosage.n: Use as directed by the regional product information

admin: Administer the oral solution/sachet as directed in the regional product information
Use as an adjunct to appropriate antimicrobial therapy when infection is present
Duration of therapy per local guidance
moa: Pidotimod is a biological response modifier with immunostimulant properties. It is reported to promote dendritic-cell maturation and antigen presentation, stimulate T-lymphocyte proliferation and differentiation, enhance phagocytosis and natural killer cell activity, and support both cell-mediated and humoral immune responses, thereby improving host resistance to recurrent infections.

absolute: Known hypersensitivity to pidotimod or any excipient
relative: Acute hyperimmune or autoimmune conditions (use with caution)

preg: Safety in pregnancy has not been established and adequate data are lacking. Use is generally avoided during pregnancy unless clearly necessary and directed by a clinician.
lact: It is not known whether pidotimod is excreted in human milk; safety during breastfeeding has not been established. Use is generally avoided during lactation.
renal: Specific dose adjustments in renal impairment are not well defined; use with caution and follow regional product information.
hepatic: Specific dose adjustments in hepatic impairment are not well defined; use with caution and follow regional product information.

minor: No clinically significant drug interactions are well established; immunosuppressants may theoretically oppose its effect
interactions.food: Generally taken away from meals per regional product information

monitoring: Frequency and severity of infections (clinical efficacy)
counsel: This medicine is used to support your immune system against repeated infections
Take it exactly as prescribed for the full recommended course
It is used alongside, not instead of, antibiotics when an active infection is present
Tell your clinician if you develop a rash, itching, or swelling
pk: Immunomodulatory effects develop over the treatment course
Rapidly absorbed orally with peak plasma concentrations within about 1-2 hours (regional data)
Short elimination half-life (approximately 4 hours; regional data)
Dosed once to twice daily per regional product information
Store as directed on the product packaging
pearls: Pidotimod is NOT FDA-approved; it is marketed in parts of Europe (e.g. Italy) and Asia as an immunostimulant. Dosing and indications here reflect regional SmPC/product information, not an FDA label
Used as an adjunct for recurrent respiratory or urinary infections, especially in children and the elderly - not a substitute for antibiotics in active infection
Generally well tolerated; hypersensitivity is the main safety concern
Evidence base is largely from regional trials; clinical benefit remains debated
Verify dose against the specific local product label, as formulations and strengths vary
missed: If a dose is missed, take it as soon as remembered unless it is nearly time for the next dose, in which case skip it and continue the usual schedule. Do not take a double dose.
overdose: Overdose experience is limited. No specific antidote exists; manage supportively and symptomatically, and contact a poison control center if a large amount is ingested.
